description: This Java class, EmailTemplatesUtils, provides utility methods for generating and sending various email notifications within an e-commerce web application. It includes methods for sending order confirmation, registration, contact, order status updates, download instructions, and password change notifications, leveraging email templates and address formatting.

classes.name: EmailTemplatesUtils
classes.description: A utility component for composing and sending email notifications related to orders, registration, contact inquiries, status updates, downloads, and password changes in an e-commerce platform.

methods.name: sendOrderEmail
methods.description: Sends an order confirmation email to a customer after a purchase, including order details, billing and shipping addresses, and order totals, formatted with HTML templates.

methods.name: sendRegistrationEmail
methods.description: Sends a welcome email to a new customer upon registration, providing access credentials and links.

methods.name: sendContactEmail
methods.description: Sends an email containing contact form details from a customer inquiry to the store's support email.

methods.name: sendUpdateOrderStatusEmail
methods.description: Notifies a customer of changes in their order status, including comments from order status history.

methods.name: sendOrderDownloadEmail
methods.description: Sends instructions for downloading purchased digital goods, with a link and expiry info.

methods.name: changePasswordNotificationEmail
methods.description: Sends a notification email to a customer when their password has been changed.
